main_body: A fenced vegetable and grain field: a wooden post-and-rail fence around a large flat crop plot (wheat, lettuce rows, cabbages, seedlings in soil rows).
top_band: At x=56, rows 1-5 are the light cap of a fence post (#b77541/#d9a566), then dark wood. Beyond the posts there is no top band on the main body. The field itself is a flat plan view of crop rows.
evidence: The main body (the crop field) is a top-down plan with no front face. The rows of wheat, cabbages and soil are painted flat as seen from straight above. The fence rails are drawn in front elevation, with only a 1-2px light highlight on each rail and no readable horizontal top surface. The posts have only a small square cap. The piece is not an open frame with beams and a base showing top faces, so the kind label does not fit and it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood (0% neutral edge pixels). The wood posts and rails show about 5 steps, and the greens, wheat and soil use several tones with grain and per-plant clumps. There are no flat 5x5 fills (0% coverage). The median of 11 colours per tile and 26 colours in total is below the references (17-20 per tile, 38-40 colours) but still close to Beodeul's typical density. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
